title: fix(app-shell,console): the shell package list, AI chat lists and studio-design reads and writes send the stored bearer token
body:
Fixes #37080

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:浏览器里只剩登录令牌(会话 Cookie 被替换、拦截或清掉)的用户,侧边栏、应用头部、命令面板和 Studio 入口里的应用包列表不再消失,AI 对话列表、建议权限绑定、提交历史、草稿面板等也正常加载;只用 Cookie 登录的用户看不到任何变化。
- 为什么做:控制台其它请求都会带上登录令牌,这一批读写漏带,属于"控制台登录状态体验"这一块的缺陷,替所有处于这种登录状态的用户解决,并加了一道测试防止以后再写出漏带令牌的请求。
- 出错会怎样:最坏情况是这些地方重新读不到数据,与修复前一样;不改服务端接受什么、不改登录方式,可以直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

Same-server `/api/` reads and writes in app-shell and the console that called the bare global `fetch` with `credentials: 'include'` (the session cookie and nothing else) now go through `createAuthenticatedFetch` from `@object-ui/auth`, exactly as #37077 did for the Setup pages: built per call (`createAuthenticatedFetch()(input, init)`, a local `authFetch` in each module), `credentials: 'include'` kept on every call, so the cookie still rides along and a `401` now reaches the console's session-ended check. No second auth-fetch helper and no new export. Nothing changes in what the server accepts.

The measured case: under a bearer-only session, `readPackagesPayload` (`GET /api/v1/packages`, the session's held package list read by the sidebar, the app header, the command palette and the Studio entries) sends the bearer and the list loads (pinned below).

### The family, measured at `origin/main` 63ab4794

79 non-test files under `ui/packages/app-shell/src` and `ui/apps/console/src` contain `credentials: 'include'`. Read call by call (AST scan of every `credentials: 'include'` property and the call it is handed to):

**Converted here: 64 calls in 39 files.**

| File | Calls |
|---|---|
| `app-shell/.../studio-design/packages-io.ts` | `readPackagesPayload` (`GET /api/v1/packages`, the measured case), `ensureCustomizationPackage`, `duplicatePackage` |
| `app-shell/.../studio-design/packageCustomizations-io.ts`, `PackageSwitcher.tsx`, `AutomationsPillar.tsx`, `FlowItemMoreMenu.tsx` | 1 each (customizations read, switcher list, automation status, flow clone) |
| `app-shell/src/hooks/useConversationList.ts` | 4 (list, detail, rename, delete) |
| `app-shell/src/hooks/useChatConversation.ts` | 3 (read, create, update) |
| `app-shell/src/console/ai/buildDebugApi.ts` | 1 (build-debug report) |
| `app-shell/src/hooks/useAiUsage.ts` | 1 |
| `app-shell/src/services/suggestedBindingsApi.ts` | 4 (list, confirm, dismiss, reopen) |
| `app-shell/src/preview/commitHistory.ts` | 2 (timeline, revert) |
| `app-shell/src/preview/DraftChangesPanel.tsx`, `UnpublishedAppBar.tsx`, `usePendingDrafts.ts` | 2, 1, 1 |
| `app-shell/src/preview/flowDraftChecks.ts` | the default transport (`opts.fetchImpl ?? createAuthenticatedFetch()`) |
| `app-shell/src/views/changeOwner.ts` | the fallback transport (`apiFetch ?? createAuthenticatedFetch()`) |
| `app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/` `PackageFormDialog.tsx`, `catalog-activation.ts`, `permission-set-clone.ts`, `sharing-rule-catalog.ts` | 1, 2, 1, 1 |
| `app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/` `FlowReferenceField.tsx`, `connector-input-fields.ts` | 2, 1 |
| `app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/` `FlowRunsPanel.tsx`, `useFlowNodePalette.ts`, `PagePreview.tsx` | 1, 1, 2 |
| `app-shell/src/views/setup/` `packagedActionLedger.ts`, `packagedFlowLedger.ts` | 2, 1 |
| `app-shell/src/hooks/` `useRecordApprovals.ts`, `sharedUserFeeds.ts`, `useInboxBell.ts` | 1 each |
| `app-shell/src/console/` `AppNoAccessEmptyState.tsx`, `connect/ConnectAgentWidget.tsx`, `deployment-notice/deploymentNoticeState.ts` | 1, 2, 2 |
| `app-shell/src/console/marketplace/marketplaceApi.ts` | 5 same-server calls onto the existing `serverFetch` (`/cloud-connection/install`, `install-namespace`, `installation`, and on the control plane its own `install_package` action and installed-state route) |
| `app-shell/src/layout/designModeMenuSave.ts` | 1 (`/api/v1/i18n/locales`) |
| `app-shell/src/layout/ContextSelectors.tsx` | 1, with `{ sameOriginOnly: true }`: the endpoint is author-written (`optionsSource.endpoint`) and may name another host |
| `console/src/pages/developer/` `AgentConnectSection.tsx`, `IntegrationsPage.tsx` | 2, 1 |
| `console/src/pages/auth/DeviceAuthPage.tsx` | 3 (claim, approve, deny: a signed-in act) |

Of the card's named ones: `packages-io.ts` `readPackagesPayload`, `useConversationList`, `useChatConversation`, `suggestedBindingsApi` and the studio-design writes (ensure-customization, duplicate, customizations, flow clone) are all converted. `suggestedBindingsApi`, `useRecordApprovals`, `sharedUserFeeds`, `useInboxBell`, `ConnectAgentWidget`, `deploymentNoticeState` and three `marketplaceApi` calls already set the bearer header by hand (`authHeaders` / `bearerAuthHeaders` / `withEnvAuth`), so those were not cookie-only; they are converted anyway for the session-ended check and the one mechanism, and their hand-rolled header is left in place (the wrapper sets the same value).

**Already authenticated or injected (not the family): 24 files.** `settings/api.ts`, `AuditLogPage.tsx`, `approvalsApi.ts`, `studioEntry.ts`, `ExcelImportBar.tsx`, `CloudAiModelStatus.tsx`, `useEnvironmentEntitlements.ts`, `storageUsageEndpoint.ts`, `ImpersonationBanner.tsx`, `useImpersonationExit.ts`, `RecordAttachmentsPanel.tsx`, `RecordDetailView.tsx`, `useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx`, `AccessExplainPanel.tsx`, `MetadataTypeActions.tsx`, `PackagesPage.tsx`, `DatasourceResourcePage.tsx`, `personalViews.ts`, `connectorConnections.ts`, `connectorCredentials.ts`, and the injected transports of `myPreferences.ts`, `slackDoors.ts`, `orgEnvironments.ts`, `useLauncherApps.tsx`. `App.tsx` names the string in a comment only.

**Left, on the pin's shrink-only list: 21 calls in 15 files**, each with its reason in the pin (`sameServerFetch.bearer.ratchet.test.ts`, `ALLOWED`):

- `console/src/LocalizationFetchProvider.tsx` (1) and `console/src/languageSeed.ts` (not counted by the pin: it hands `sharedGetJson` a transport argument that may be `undefined`): the boot read of `/api/v1/auth/me/localization`, shared in flight by a key built from the init with the early request `index.html` sends. A session it cannot see reads `authenticated: false` and falls back to the browser language rather than failing. Its transport is its own decision (Acceptance notes).
- `console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` (1): the bare channel is the public form route's on purpose.
- `console/src/lib/auth-preflight.ts`, `console/src/lib/early-discovery.ts` (1 each): set the bearer header themselves on purpose.
- `console/src/pages/auth/OAuthConsentPage.tsx` (3), `followAuthorize.ts` (1), `handoffClientName.ts` (1): the OAuth hand-off, whose authorize step is a top-level navigation that can only carry the cookie.
- `console/src/pages/auth/SetupPage.tsx`, `app-shell/src/console/auth/bootstrapStatus.ts`, `console/src/pages/auth/VerifyEmailPage.tsx`, `app-shell/src/chrome/ConditionalAuthWrapper.tsx`, `app-shell/src/runtime-config.ts` (1 each): read before or without a session.
- `app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx` (1): an open PR (#37123) edits this file; its call moves with that work.
- `app-shell/src/console/marketplace/marketplaceApi.ts` (5): each targets `getCloudBase() || SERVER_URL`, the cloud control plane's own origin whenever one is configured, which must never see this runtime's bearer.
- `app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/ActionPreview.tsx` (1): the test request of an `api` action preview, sent to the author-written target; its transport is not decided here.

The other two fenced files hold no family call: `RecordDetailView.tsx` and `useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx` already route every `credentials: 'include'` call through their `authFetch`. Neither was edited.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/sameServerFetch.bearer.ratchet.test.ts` (new, the enumeration pin; runs in **Test UI**, app-shell's `unit` project): parses every non-test source file of both trees with the TypeScript parser and refuses a bare cookie-only call (the transport is the global `fetch`, `window.fetch`, `globalThis.fetch`, `self.fetch`, one of those as a `??` / `||` fallback, or `sharedGetJson` without its transport argument; the init carries `credentials: 'include'`, inline or as a `const` of the file, `as const` included). The URL is not judged: a call that must stay bare is a counted row with its reason. Four cases: the scan reads both trees (more than 500 and 100 files); a 13-case detector battery (each bare spelling found, each authenticated one not); every bare call is a counted row; every row is still exact (a file that sheds a call must shrink its row).
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/packages-io.bearerSession.test.ts` (new): against a server that refuses any request without the bearer, with a token stored, `fetchPackages` loads the list and its one request carries `Authorization: Bearer TOKEN` and `credentials: 'include'`; `fetchListedPackageIds` likewise; the duplicate write, the commit timeline and revert, suggested bindings and the build-debug report carry the bearer. Each with a cookie-only control (no token stored: no `Authorization`, `credentials: 'include'`).

Test doubles that moved (118 files, no assertion weakened):

- 102 files: hand-rolled `Response` doubles (`{ ok, status, json }`) gain `headers: new Headers()`, the headers a real `Response` carries and the authenticated fetch reads (`set-auth-token`), as #37077 did. The 102nd, `StudioPaletteGroups.surfaceScope-36900` (the command-palette suite that reached `main` after round 0), doubles `GET /api/v1/packages`: without the headers the converted `readPackagesPayload` threw on the double and the palette drew no Packages group. For `fetchInstalledPackageRow-7881` and `StudioDesignSurface.readOnlyPosture-12453` the headers are added at the one stub instead of each answer.
- 8 files whose `@object-ui/auth` mock answered `createAuthenticatedFetch: () => vi.fn()` (a transport that answers nothing) now hand the authenticated fetch's requests to the global `fetch` the file already stubs: the four `RecordApprovalsPanel` suites and `RecordDetailView` `editLockedByState-32756`, `phoneFace-27058`, `userActionPredicates`, `harness`.
- 5 `RecordDetailView` approval suites whose `authFetchSpy` stands for the action door: approvals reads (now through the authenticated fetch too) are handed to the file's wire double, as before (`approvalRecallGate`, `accessEndedAfterDecision-26589`, `approvalDeclaredActions`, `approvalLock-12220`, `approvalLock-25934`).
- `StudioRoute.searchPalette-11863` (console): its auth mock answers the Studio permissions read and hands every other request (the package list) to the wire double.
- 3 assertions read the init the wire received (the last two files are also among the 101): `useConversationList` and `BuildDebugDrawer` assert `{ credentials: 'include', headers: expect.any(Headers) }` (exact keys, as before); `DraftChangesPanel.flowChecks-34818` reads `Accept-Language` off a `Headers`.
- `RecordDetailView.headerApiInterpolation`: the flow-trigger case asserts exactly one call to the trigger door, filtered by its path, since the page's own reads now share that spy.

## Acceptance notes

- Same defect family outside the two trees, not touched (the card scopes the `plugin-*` hooks out unless measured here): `credentials: 'include'` with the bare `fetch` remains in `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot` (`useAgents`, `useAiModels`, `useHitlInChat`, `usePendingActions`), `plugin-detail` (`queueClaim`, `stageChangeStarts`, `useRecordEditable`), `plugin-grid` (`useRecordCrudVerdicts`, `useRowApprovalLocks`), `plugin-dashboard` (`DatasetWidget`), `plugin-charts` (`ObjectChart`), `fields` (`ShareableObjectRefField`, `preferenceOptions`), `components` (`ShareDialog`) and `permissions` (`MePermissionsProvider`). Not each read call by call.
- A bare `fetch('/api/…')` with no init at all is cookie-only as well (the default `same-origin` credentials) and is outside the pin's spelling: `views/metadata-admin/widgets.tsx` `fetchFieldSelectorOptions` (`GET /api/v1/objects/:name/fields`).
- `LocalizationFetchProvider` and `languageSeed` read `/api/v1/auth/me/localization` cookie-only; under a bearer-only session that read answers anonymously and the console falls back to the browser language instead of the user's own locale. Not measured in a browser; left because the request key is shared with the early request `index.html` sends.
- The hand-rolled bearer helpers left beside converted calls (`authHeaders` in `suggestedBindingsApi`, `bearerAuthHeaders`, `withEnvAuth`) are now redundant there; not removed here.

The ratchet's detector battery first went red on a real detector issue: at a script's top level `await (x)(…)` parses as a call of `await`, so the `(apiFetch ?? fetch)` case read 0; the cases now run inside an async function.
</details>
